Author(s): Zhe-Qi Yang, Lei Chen, and Zhi-Rong Zhong

We theoretically propose a scheme for the generation of $n$-phonon and photon-phonon pair bundle emissions in a cavity magnomechanics system. By utilizing the Barnett effect under resonant driving, $n$-phonon and photon-phonon super Rabi oscillations can be achieved. Through the system's dissipative…
